name: cache-clock
description: Band line showing whether Claude's prompt cache is still warm. TTL, expiry, and hit ratio come from Claude Code's prompt_cache when /cache-clock setup is installed; otherwise the countdown is an estimate.

cacheMinutes.title: Fallback cache lifetime in minutes
cacheMinutes.description: Used only when Claude Code's prompt_cache is unavailable (run /cache-clock setup) and no promptCacheTtl, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, or ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H is set. 5 = API key, cloud provider, or usage credits. 60 = Claude subscription within plan. The band marks this guess with ?.
